<section class="band" id="approach" style="padding-top:0">
  <div class="wrap">

      <div class="step"><span class="w">Plan</span><p>Brief, scope and the level of detail each deliverable needs. BIM Execution Plan, standards and Common Data Environment set up.</p></div>

      <div class="step"><span class="w">Coordinate</span><p>Architecture, structure, MEP and facade reviewed together. Clashes and RFIs closed before they reach site.</p></div>
